## Change

Describe the problem and resulting behavior. Link a related issue if available.

## Validation

Describe the checks performed and their results. For GUI changes, include a
small screenshot when useful. Note any checks that require unavailable hardware,
models, credentials, or local datasets.

## Checklist

- [ ] The change is focused and relevant documentation is updated.
- [ ] `python scripts/check_repository.py` passes.
- [ ] Relevant local validation is described above.
- [ ] No credentials, datasets, writable caches, or local test folders are staged.
